item.title: Version 2.1.0
item.description:
Added

  • Launch a campaign step by step. A new guided launcher walks you from an app to live campaigns: pick the app and a strategy, choose your markets, research keywords country by country, set your budgets, and see the whole plan before any of it exists. Campaigns are created paused, with progress for each one and an undo, so nothing starts spending until you decide it should.
  • See how big a market is before you enter it. The world map can now size countries by population instead of your spend, and each country shows its market context as you hover. These are bundled third-party estimates rather than Apple Ads data, and any market without a credible published figure is left out rather than guessed at.
  • Pause campaigns, ad groups, keywords, and ads from the command line. The adswift CLI can now pause anything that’s spending — right from the terminal — so you can stop spend fast. Turning things back on still happens in the app, where you can review the full picture before money starts flowing again.

Improved

  • A more up-to-date command-line tool. A new adswift refresh command pulls the latest campaign, ad group, and keyword data on demand, the CLI now recovers automatically when it’s looking at something created moments ago elsewhere, and its messages make it clearer when data might be a little stale.
  • Your campaigns stay on screen while they refresh. Switching campaign groups — or reloading — no longer blanks the table out to a placeholder. The rows you were reading stay put and the numbers fill in as they arrive.

Fixed

  • Apps that run in more than one campaign group. When the same app has campaigns in two campaign groups, selecting it in one group no longer highlights it in the other. Each group’s copy of the app is now selected, expanded, and switched to independently — including apps you’ve added to a group that has no campaigns yet.
